summary: Updated openssl packages fix security vulnerabilities
details:
Incorrect Failure Handling in RSA KEM RSASVE Encapsulation.
(CVE-2026-31790)

NULL Pointer Dereference When Processing a Delta CRL. (CVE-2026-28388)

(CVE-2026-28389)

(CVE-2026-28390)
